subject: Request: Pilot extension + combined credits/discount for SummitAI
messages:
From: Ayesha Qureshi <ayesha.qu@summitai.ai>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 15:12:05 -0400
Subject: Pilot extension and combined credits/discount ask

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week — SummitAI's team ran a short burst of tests against the recommendation model and we saw promising QoQ improvements. We're at the tail end of our 30-day trial but need a little more runway to validate latency under production-like traffic and evaluate cost at scale.

Two asks from our side:
- A 30-day extension of the trial period.
- A one-time promotional package: 60,000 free inference credits + a 20% promotional discount on usage during an initial 90-day window.

We believe this helps us get across the finish line for a $240k ARR pilot (projected) and gives enough time to complete security review. If there are any forms or procurement steps we should complete, please let us know. I've attached our short request statement and a usage snapshot.

Appreciate your help — happy to hop on a quick call if needed.

Thanks,
Ayesha Qureshi
Head of ML Engineering, SummitAI
ayesha.qu@summitai.ai
SummitAI, Inc.

Attachments: SummitAI_request_statement.pdf, SummitAI_usage_snapshot.csv

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Ayesha Qureshi <ayesha.qu@summitai.ai>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 17:02:10 -0400
Subject: Re: Pilot extension and combined credits/discount ask

Hi Ayesha —

Thanks for the detail and for sharing the usage snapshot. We're excited to see the signal and would like to keep momentum. Short answer: we can support an extension and a promotional package, but the combined credits + discount for the size you're requesting requires an exec exception.

Proposed next steps from my side:
1) I'll summarize commercial ask and impact and escalate to revenue leadership + finance for approval.
2) If approved, we'll generate a short amendment/PO that covers the extended trial dates, credit allocation, and limited-time discount.
3) We typically require an MSA acceptance or PO that references the pilot terms before activating credits.

Can you confirm the expected pilot start/end dates post-extension and the target MRC if we roll into paid? That will help the finance team with modeling.

I'll loop in Lauren and Marissa for the approval path.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:30:00 -0400
Subject: Fwd: Pilot extension and combined credits/discount ask — SummitAI (need exec exception)

Team — forwarding SummitAI's ask. TL;DR: 60k free inference credits + 20% discount for 90 days + 30-day trial extension. Customer projects ~ $240k ARR from a pilot if they can validate latency/cost. Attachments: usage snapshot and customer request.

Why I'm asking for exception: 60k credits at their projected call volume materially increases our front-loaded cost. If we get them to sign MSA/PO and commit to a commercial path, the ARR upside is meaningful. Proposed compromise for approval: 50k one-time credits + 20% discount for 60 days, conditional on signed PO and a 6-month convertible credit offset if they go to production.

Please see the quick cost model I've attached (credit_cost_model.xlsx) — shows token-equivalent burn and expected realization if SummitAI converts.

Requesting:
- Marissa: exec signoff for marketing/sales exception (50k credits + 20% for shortened window)
- Rishi/Finance: confirm accounting treatment and whether this can be booked as a promotional expense vs. revenue credit; any constraints on threshold.
- Lauren: if approved, can you prepare the PO amendment + DocuSign?

Happy to jump on a 15-min call to walk through.

Thanks,
Ben

Attachments: credit_cost_model.xlsx, SummitAI_request_statement.pdf

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 12:05:15 -0400
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot extension and combined credits/discount ask — SummitAI (need exec exception)

Ben —

Thanks for the clear summary. I'm inclined to support a concession here given the potential ARR uplift and product-fit signal. That said, I want to limit downside. I approve the following, conditional on finance signoff and customer commitment:

- Grant 40,000 free inference credits up front
- Approve a 15% promotional discount on usage for 60 days following extension
- Waive the standard onboarding service fee for the pilot

Two asks before I execute:
1) Rishi — confirm that the credits can be treated as a promotional expense and confirm the threshold for executive-level signoff if SummitAI pushes for the full 60k + 20%.
2) Ben/Lauren — please capture the commitment (PO or MSA signature) and include an explicit conversion target (e.g., $20k MRC committed within 90 days after pilot) in the amendment.

Marissa
VP, Sales Operations
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 13:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot extension and combined credits/discount ask — SummitAI (need exec exception)

Quick finance read: we can treat credits as a marketing/promotional expense (write-off) provided there's a documented conversion play and a measurable uplift target. For the amount requested, I need a committed handoff: either a PO referencing the pilot amendment or an MSA signed and a Letter of Intent with expected MRC.

If Marissa wants to authorize additional credits beyond 40k, I need a short note on projected conversion probability and expected ARR capture. Based on the cost model Ben shared, approving 50k credits + 20% for 60 days would be acceptable only if SummitAI signs an MSA and commits to at least $20k MRC within 90 days post-pilot — otherwise finance will cap to the 40k/15% that Marissa outlined.

If we need final exec approval beyond Marissa (i.e., >50k credits or >20% discount), we'll need Vivek's signoff.

Rishi
Director, Revenue Ops & Finance
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

Reviewed the thread and the cost model. Given the projected ARR and the strategic fit (strong evaluation results + low sales motion complexity), I will authorize a conditional exception. Approval below:

- One-time credits: 50,000 free inference credits to be applied after MSA/PO execution
- Promotional discount: 20% off usage for 60 days after the extension period
- Conditions:
  * SummitAI signs the MSA or issues PO that references deal SUM-2027-0420 within 14 days of amendment issuance
  * Customer commits to a minimum of $20k MRC within 90 days post-pilot or credits convert to a marketing expense write-off
  * Legal/Procurement to keep standard indemnities; no permanent pricing changes beyond the 60-day window

Lauren — please prepare an amendment and DocuSign envelope referencing the above. Include the credit redemption schedule and the conversion clause. Ben — please secure the PO/MSA and confirm once signed so we can apply credits.
